title: Deployment
description: A signal deployment to a specific deployment target with activation status and key

type.description: Discriminator indicating this is a platform-based deployment

is_live.description: Whether signal is currently active on this deployment

activation_key.description: The key to use for targeting. Only present if is_live=true AND requester has access to this deployment.

estimated_activation_duration_minutes.description: Estimated time to activate if not live, or to complete activation if in progress

type.description: Discriminator indicating this is an agent URL-based deployment

is_live.description: Whether signal is currently active on this deployment

activation_key.description: The key to use for targeting. Only present if is_live=true AND requester has access to this deployment.

estimated_activation_duration_minutes.description: Estimated time to activate if not live, or to complete activation if in progress

delivery_state.description: Arrival of provider-initiated delivery; separate from is_live and match_status. Experimental (signals.delivery_methods).

delivery.description: What was shipped, shaped like core/audience-source.json; the destination-side join key. Omitted when the rail has no vendor-addressable artifact. Never a credential. Experimental.

vendor.description: Vendor whose rails delivered the artifact.

delivery_error.description: Why delivery failed; present when delivery_state is failed. UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE when no declared rail intersects or the pin does not match. Experimental.

match_status.description: Match outcome using the audience-status vocabulary (enums/audience-status.json); optional and rail-independent. too_small implies is_live false. Experimental.

matched_count.description: Members matched; absence is not zero.

effective_match_rate.description: Deduplicated match rate; absence is not zero.
